newsitem.title: BOTSWANA: Debswana mines set for continuous operation.
newsitem.headline: Debswana mines set for continuous operation.

text.p: Debswana, the 50/50 diamond mining partnership betwen the Botswana government and De Beers, said on Thursday it would introduce continuous operations at its three mines in Botswana from January 1.

The company is expecting a 15 percent increase in ore moved as a result of the move, which means mines will in future work Sundays. But it declined to forecast how this would impact on gem production, currently running at 17 million carats a year.
"This will obviously depend on the areas worked...and we might decide to exploit lower grade parts of the mines," company secretray Joe Matome said.
The issue of continuous operations has been under discussion with the Botswana Mining Workers' Union for almost two years.
The mines will operate for 352 days of the year.
